title: Achievable Fairness on Your Data With Utility Guarantees
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on fairness related to sensitive attributes such as race and gender.
findings: Not applicable. The paper's analysis of fairness does not include religion as a sensitive attribute, and therefore, there are no findings related to it.
